genesis.note: Aiken genesis.spend EndGenesis does not require a founder key — only slot >= genesis_end_slot (or steward/oracle/bioregion thresholds) plus an output with genesis_active=False. If a genesis UTxO is still active, a burner can try to close it. WASM node 'never spend genesis' is stricter than this validator.

pnft.warning: This pNFT sits at a payment key, not a script address. A burner cannot spend it (missing vkey). The *holder* wallet can send it like any native asset unless the mint policy forbids transfer. Do not load that mnemonic into the red-team .env.
